name: Login
whenToUse: Authenticate a user with email plus password, 2FA, or passkey assertion to obtain a CompanyUser session (mutating).

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description:
Include child relations of the CompanyUser object, format is comma separated.
> ### **Note**: it is possible to chain multiple includes together, ie. include=account,token
```html Available includes: user company token account ```

queryParameters.name: include_static
queryParameters.description:
This include will return the full set of static variables used in the application including:
  - Currencies
  - Countries
  - Languages
  - Payment Types
  - Email Templatees
  - Industries

queryParameters.name: clear_cache
queryParameters.description:
Clears cache

Clears (and rebuilds) the static variable cache.

headerParameters.name: X-API-SECRET
headerParameters.description: The API secret as defined by the .env variable API_SECRET. Only needed for self hosted users, and only applicable on the login route.

fields.name: password
fields.description: The user password. Optional when performing passkey passwordless login.

fields.name: one_time_password
fields.description: The one time password if 2FA is enabled

fields.name: passkey_challenge_token
fields.description: Challenge token returned by passkey login options or second-factor challenge.
